int_between: {where} {name} must be an integer between {low} and {high}
number_between: {where} {name} must be a number between {low} and {high}
relay_url: {where} relay_url: https:// address of the relay expected (http:// only to 127.0.0.1)
module_not_run: {where} enabled but “{module}” missing from [modules] run: the module would never be started
unknown_root_key: unknown key at the top level: {key}
rig.port: [rig] port: required for a real transceiver
rig.max_power_w: [rig] max_power_w must be between 0 and 2000 (0 = unknown)
rig.tx_modes: [rig] tx_modes: “{mode}” is not a valid mode name
rig.extra_conf_reserved: [rig] extra_conf: {keys} not allowed here (set by [spectrum]; the Hamlib UDP command server has no authentication)
rig.extra_conf_cache: [rig] extra_conf: cache_timeout not allowed (the station turns off the rigctld cache: otherwise reading the PTT back returns the commanded value instead of the real state of the transceiver)
clients.one_secret: [[clients]] {id}: exactly one secret is needed (password_hash, or failing that token)
clients.pseudo_invalid: {where}: invalid nickname ({max} characters at most, no control character, no leading or trailing space)
clients.pseudo_is_id: {where}: the nickname “{pseudo}” is the login of an account (it would be shown to the other connected users)
clients.listener_admin: {where}: a listener cannot be an administrator (admin = true is for operators only)
clients.expires_format: {where}: expires must be a YYYY-MM-DD date
clients.expires_invalid: {where}: expires “{expires}” is not a valid date
network.trusted_proxies: [network] trusted_proxies: “{proxy}” is not an IP address or a CIDR network
network.ice_servers: [network] ice_servers: “{server}” must start with stun: or turn:
network.rigctld_host: [network] rigctld_host must stay local: rigctld has no authentication
network.exposure: The API would listen on {bind} WITHOUT encryption: passwords in clear text on the network. Set tls_cert/tls_key, put an HTTPS proxy in front (gateway_bind = 127.0.0.1), or, if the traffic is already encrypted by a VPN, allow_insecure_http = true.
safety.tot: Maximum transmission time (TOT) of {tot} s refused: it must be between 1 and {ceiling} s, the ceiling of this station ([safety] tot_s, ceiling tot_ceiling_s)
safety.warn_before: The warning beep ({warn} s before the cut-off) must sound during the transmission: less than the maximum time ({tot} s) ([safety] warn_before_s)
safety.heartbeat: [safety] heartbeat_timeout_ms must be at least 2x heartbeat_interval_ms
safety.rig_temp: Transceiver temperature thresholds refused ({warn} and {cut} °C): the warning must be lower than the cut-off, both between {low} and {high} °C ([safety] rig_temp_warn_c, rig_temp_cut_c)
supervisor.tot_abs: [supervisor] tot_abs_s must be strictly greater than safety.tot_ceiling_s
supervisor.local_tx_max: [supervisor] local_tx_max_s must be an integer between 1 and {ceiling} s
supervisor.stale_after: [supervisor] stale_after_s must be at least 0.5 s (the gateway writes every 0.25 s)
supervisor.alert_pct: [supervisor] {name} must be 0 (no alert) or an integer from 50 to 99 (%)
supervisor.alive_every_h: [supervisor] alive_every_h must be 0 (no heartbeat) or between 0.25 and 168 hours
supervisor.service_mode: [supervisor] service_mode must be auto, systemd or managed
supervisor.notify_url: [supervisor] notify_url must start with http:// or https://
supervisor.notify_lang: [supervisor] notify_lang must be fr or en (languages of the error catalogue)
modules.run_name: [modules] run: “{name}” is not a valid module name
modules.run_twice: [modules] run: a module is listed twice
modules.bus_port_clash: [modules] bus_port must differ from gateway_port, rigctld_port and instance_lock_port
modules.run_as: [modules] run_as: “{account}” is not a valid account name
modules.run_as_root: [modules] run_as: a module must never run as root
selcall.tx_level: [selcall] tx_level_dbfs: from -30 to -1 dBFS (below the ALC threshold)
spectrum.max_fps: [spectrum] max_fps: from 1 to 20 frames per second
spectrum.port_missing: [spectrum] port: give the second port of the transceiver (e.g. COM7), or enabled = false
spectrum.port_is_cat: [spectrum] port {port}: this is the CAT or PTT port of the transceiver; the SECOND port, set to CI-V, is needed
spectrum.civ_address: [spectrum] civ_address: CI-V address of the transceiver in hexadecimal, from 01 to DF (e.g. B6)
spectrum.icom_only: [spectrum] source civ_port: Icom transceivers only (Hamlib model 3xxx)
spectrum.speed: [spectrum] the spectrum requires [rig] speed = {min_speed} at least (current speed {speed}): at a lower speed it would saturate the link and delay the PTT commands
cluster.blacklist: [cluster] blacklist: callsigns in capitals, “XX*” for a prefix
cluster.source_name: [[cluster.source]] name {name}: letters, digits, - and _ (32 at most)
cluster.source_secret: {label}: secret = NAME of the password in secrets.toml (letters, digits, - and _)
cluster.call_required: [cluster] call: YOUR callsign is required to connect to the clusters and to the RBN ({problem})
netprobe.signal_thresholds: [netprobe] the signal alert thresholds must be lower than the warning thresholds
breizh.host_private: [breizh] host: private IP address of the Breizh PC expected (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x, 127.x, fd00::/8, fe80::/10); neither a host name nor a public address (the microphone travels in clear)
breizh.host_required: [breizh] host: address of the Breizh PC required (or enabled = false)
breizh.lost_ms: [breizh] lost_ms must be greater than block_timeout_ms
breizh.fallback_gain: [breizh] fallback_gain_db must be a number between -20 and 0 dB
breizh.reactivate: [breizh] reactivate_after_s must be 0 (manual only) or an integer between 30 and 3600
breizh.port_taken: [breizh] port: already in use on this machine (gateway, rigctld, module bus or supervisor)
freedv.program: [freedv] {name}: program path (or its name, looked up in the PATH) expected
freedv.locator: [freedv] locator: Maidenhead locator of 4 or 6 characters expected (e.g. JN18 or JN18du), or empty
sdr.serial: [sdr] serial: serial number of the SDR (letters and digits, 4 to 32), see “trx-sdr --list”
sdr.core_path: [sdr] core_path: path of the sdr-core program, or empty
sdr.bins: [sdr] bins: power of 2 from 128 to fft_size
sdr.no_serial: [sdr] enabled without serial: the SDR must be designated by its serial number (“trx-sdr --list”), never picked at random
remote_console.account: [remote_console] account: “{account}” is not an account name (lower case, digits, _ . -)
remote_console.port_range: [remote_console] port must be a port number between 1024 and 65535 (read: {port})
remote_console.port_taken: [remote_console] port {port} already used by the station (control page or rigctld): choose another one
remote_console.idle_min: [remote_console] idle_min must be between 5 and 240 minutes (read: {idle})
remote_console.no_admin: [remote_console] enabled without any administrator operator account (admin = true, with a password): nobody could log in (menu 4.6)
warn.no_band: No band allowed: transmitting will be IMPOSSIBLE (receive only).
warn.bands_off: Band check DISABLED: only the transceiver prevents transmitting outside the bands (check its setting, e.g. “TX limit” on an Icom).
warn.no_audio: Audio devices not set: no audio until they are filled in.
warn.spectrum_speed: [spectrum] enabled with the Hamlib default speed: set [rig] speed = {min_speed} (and the same CI-V speed in the transceiver menu).
warn.token: Some clients still use a clear-text token: replace it with a hashed password (trx-setup --set-password NAME).
warn.no_client: No authorised client ([[clients]]): no remote access (trx-setup --add-client NAME).
warn.no_notify: No alert URL (notify_url): the supervisor's recoveries will not be notified.
warn.ptt_rts_dtr: PTT by RTS/DTR: check that opening the port does not trigger a short transmission at start-up or on a USB reset.
password.too_short: {min} characters minimum (a long passphrase is better)
password.spaces: must not start or end with a space
probe.fallback: Normal mode: a single port, no HF waterfall.
probe.usb_send_warning:
BEFORE OPENING THE SECOND PORT, check on the transceiver (MENU > SET > Connectors):
  - “USB SEND”, “USB Keying (CW)” and “USB Keying (RTTY)”: none of them may use this port
    (OFF, or a line of the CAT port only). Otherwise opening it can PUT THE TRANSCEIVER ON THE AIR.
  - function of the second port (“USB Serial Function” or equivalent): CI-V.
  - dummy load or antenna connected, power at minimum (as a precaution: nothing is transmitted).
probe.open_failed: port {port} cannot be opened ({detail}): transceiver off, cable unplugged, port number changed, or port held by another program.
probe.no_answer: no CI-V answer on {port}: the second port is not (or no longer) set to CI-V in the transceiver menu (MENU > SET > Connectors), or its speed has changed.
probe.wrong_address: the transceiver answers on {port} at address {detail} instead of {expected}: CI-V address changed in the transceiver menu (correct it, or run trx-setup --spectre {port} again).
probe.no_scope: the transceiver refuses the spectrum settings on {port}: this transceiver does not provide the spectrum over CI-V.
probe.other_rig: {port} does not show the same frequency as the CAT port ({detail}): it is not the same transceiver.
probe.ptt_on_open: opening {port} PUT THE TRANSCEIVER ON THE AIR: a “USB SEND” or “USB Keying” setting of the transceiver uses this port. Transmission cut; spectrum disabled until the station restarts.
probe.ptt_unknown: transmit state unreadable just after opening {port}: port closed again as a precaution.
probe.ptt_busy: the transceiver went on the air just after {port} was opened, but not because of this port (the transmission went on with the port closed: transceiver microphone?). Transmission left to the operator at the transceiver; new attempt later.
probe.silent: no more spectrum data on {port} for {detail} s (transceiver screen on a menu or on a screen other than the spectrum, spectrum off on the transceiver, setting changed, or cable).
probe.no_pyserial: pyserial module missing: pip install pyserial (spectrum disabled).
diffusion.server: [diffusion] server: name of the broadcast server (letters, digits, dots and hyphens)
diffusion.audio_port_clash: [diffusion] audio_port: must differ from [modules] bus_port and [sdr] audio_port
diffusion.tls_local: [diffusion] tls = false only towards 127.0.0.1 (test server): on the Internet the source password would travel in clear text
diffusion.incomplete: [diffusion] enabled without server or station: nothing could be broadcast
